integrity.finite_checks: 25 full-tree DP cases, 75 stable-pruning DP cases, 25 one-group sharp-threshold DP cases, 18 brute optimality/count cases in standalone Python and nine exhaustive structural classifications
integrity.proof_type: inductive exact three-state minimum-cost/count recurrence plus leaf-neighborhood exchange and a two-to-one mapping
integrity.uncertainty: Historical-priority and independent mathematical verification are outstanding.

scientific_limitations: Perfect rooted regular trees only; the all-pruning invariance assumes at least two retained terminal leaves at every bottom parent, while exact doubling is proved for precisely one single-leaf sibling group. No claim of novelty for the known binary-case values or generic dynamic-programming procedure.
title: Branching-dependent rigidity and sharp leaf-pruning thresholds for minimum domination of complete rooted trees
